what: Vertical dot index on the right of the screen: the dot of the last section whose head has passed the 400px line (at) from the bottom of the screen fills with the accent color, and its name appears 20px left of the dot with no curve (it stays lit until the next section’s head passes the same line). The other dots are 30% accent, and a hovered dot also fills and shows its name. Clicking a dot lights it right away and glides to 90px above the section head over 2s sine.inOut (the same formula as jQuery swing). A quiet guide for a one-page event or exhibition site

options.at: Screen line that turns on when the section top passes (ScrollTrigger position term), default bottom-=400 — to measure from the top of the screen use top+=Like 162
options.dur: Seconds of sliding after press, default 2 — 0 moves instantly
options.offset: How far above the section head it stops (px), default 90 — fixed header bar height
options.ease: Sliding curve — GSAP name or ”a,b,c,d”, default sine.inOut
options.--fx-size·--fx-gap: Dot diameter and spacing (via style), default 10px·15px
options.--fx-font·--fx-label-size·--fx-track·--f: Name font (default --kf-font-display) · size 10px · letter-spacing 2px · distance from dot 20px
options.--fx-dur: Turn-on length (via style), default 0s (original turns on immediately, no curve)

use: STORY…
note: The position (fixed · right) is set by the user. If only a current-section indicator is needed and not a dot shape, use toc-spy (on only while passing the line near the top of the screen)
